notes: «أخبرني أبي و، حدثتني أيضا، فاطمة» gives Hisham two transmitters at one level: his father (bare أبي, relation) and Fatima; the text writes «عن أسماء» once, after Fatima, so the father's route to Asma is not written and is not added
the stray «و» after أبي is the conjunction, not part of the name
